name: lispan_chem_v2
description: Phase 3b v2: the Li-SPAN PINN conditioned on the C-rate (0.1-1 C) and five chemistry inputs - dU0_2 (step 2 relative to step 1, -0.15...+0.28 V), dU0_3rel2 (step 3 relative to step 2, -0.26...+0.20 V, so the steps stay in order), b_12 (OCV-slope multiplier of steps 1-2, x0.5-1.6), b_3 (step 3, x0.4-3.5) and k0_1 (x0.1-100): the box of the Phase 2 literature fits (docs/PHASE3B_CHEM_PINN.md, 'v1 results' point 5). Network contact resistance 0, so the window covers every Z_CC >= 0; common U0 shift, Z_CC and w_S analytic. Window and evaluation cases from configs/lispan_chem_design_v2.json (1612 FV discharges, degree-4 window fit: max 3.6 %, held-out max 4.7 %, window fraction 0.95; 13 evaluation chemistries incl. three literature fits). Recipe of v1 (rollback from step 0, 10 per 20 000 steps; weights frozen at 60 000; best.pt on the select cases) plus residual-based sampling at the voltage cliffs (25 % of the cathode points from the 1024 worst of 8192 candidates, refreshed every 250 steps) and 200 000 steps.
